details: Combosquat of the OpenZeppelin contracts library. The preinstall and postinstall hooks both run index.js, which harvests environment variables whose names match KEY/TOKEN/SECRET/PASS/PRIVATE/MNEMONIC/WALLET/AWS/GITHUB/NPM/etc., reads credential and wallet files from the home directory (~/.aws/credentials, ~/.ssh/id_rsa, ~/.kube/config, ~/.docker/config.json, ~/.npmrc, ~/.git-credentials, Solana/Anchor/Sui/Foundry keystores, gcloud credentials) and.env files in the working directory, then POSTs the collected data as JSON to hxxps://webhook[.]site/326b0891-2093-4800-a4c1-686ce3e07b09 over TLS. The hook swallows all errors so installs never fail.
